remarks: Welcome to 80 County Street, Unit 2H! This inviting rental is all about modern comfort and convenience. Step into a clean, bright, and airy space that's ready for immediate occupancy. The kitchen is a chef's delight, boasting brand-new stainless steel appliances, including a sleek Maytag refrigerator, microwave, gas stove, and dishwasher. You'll enjoy the convenience of a full-sized, in-unit stackable washer and dryer. The bathroom features elegant updated tiles on both the floor and in the shower, adding a touch of sophistication. And step outside through your sliding doors onto a generous balcony overlooking a park-like setting-perfect for relaxing with a cup of coffee. The complex itself offers lush green grounds and an on-site pool for those sunny Norwalk days. Plus, **your rent includes heat and hot water** for added convenience. Location-wise, you're perfectly positioned near the Westport border and just moments from Connecticut Avenue's shopping and entertainment. This well-maintained community combines tranquility with modern upgrades. Don't miss out on making this bright, welcoming space your new home!
